description: A billiard table with a blue felt surface, set within a dark wood frame. The table has six pockets, one at each corner and one on each side. On the felt, a triangular rack of billiard balls is arranged, consisting of red, yellow, and one black ball at the apex. A single white cue ball is also visible on the table, positioned away from the rack. The table is rendered in a 3D model, appearing to float against a white background, suggesting it's a digital asset for visualization or gaming.
